requirements.text: The player must be able to input cell cordinates
requirements.description:
Basic interaction to attempt acquiring a cell, also allows grid-based gameplay
Priority:
Required to trigger system actions and challenges, High system priority
Essential to user interaction, High user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to acquire a cell
requirements.description:
Involves input validation, challenge handling, and grid updates/edits.
Priority:
Affects game logic, ownership, and state updates, High system priority
Central to gameplay experience, High user priority

requirements.text: The game must be able to edit the grid
requirements.description:
Multiplayer game so edits are real-time, important for game state consistency.
Priority:
System needs to process grid data, High system priority
Players just need to know the aftermath of what happened, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to trade cells with other players
requirements.description:
Requires a clear trade logic and fairness rules. 
Priority:
System just needs to edit any change, Medium system priority
Basic gameplay aspect , High user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to see the grid
requirements.description:
Players need to view the grid to make informed decisions 
Priority:
Mostly depends on rendering and real-time updates, Medium system priority
Crucial for navigation and interaction, High user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to give pop-up messages to players
requirements.description:
Helps with informing players about game events, errors, or instructions.
Priority:
Enhances communication and clarity, High system priority
Improves user experience and feedback, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to check player inputs
requirements.description:
Basic requirment for maintaining valid actions and rule enforcement(Game Logic)
Priority:
Essential for keeping Game Logic in check, High system priority
Ensures fair and predictable gameplay, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to accomodate 4 to 36 players
requirements.description:
Scalability requirement. 
Priority:
Session and state handling for multiple players, High system priority
Players just want to play, Low user priority

requirements.text: The game must be able to initialise a profile for each player
requirements.description:
Creates player identity and stores  preferences or settings.
Priority:
Needed for player tracking and personalization, High system priority
Important for identity and engagement, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to edit his profile
requirements.description:
Allows players to customize their identity(name, avatar, language)
Priority:
Requires validation and data persistence, Medium system priority
Improves personalization and player satisfaction, High user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to operate on browser
requirements.description:
Defines the platform for accessibility; no installation required.
Priority:
Impacts compatibility, High system priority
Enables easy access and play-anywhere experience, High user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to give challenges
requirements.description:
Triggered when a player attempts to acquire a cell; basic gameplay element
Priority:
Part of game logic and progression flow, High system priority
Directly affects player engagement and interaction, High user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to play sound effects
requirements.description:
Provides immersion and helps players follow whats happening
Priority:
Doesn’t affect game rules/state low system priority
Sound effects enhance but they’re not critical to gameplay, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to notify the player when it crashes
requirements.description:
Improves user experience in failure scenarios
Priority:
Supports error handling and recovery, High system priority
Players would like to have some help in such scenarios, Medium user priority

requirements.text: A player must be able to forfeit the game
requirements.description:
Allows a player to voluntarily concede and exit the game.
Priority:
Requires state knowledge and proper handling of game flow, High system priority
Provides control and player choice, High user priority

requirements.text: The game must be able to color each cell according to its player
requirements.description:
Visual feedback that depends on accurate player data
Priority:
Mostly a front-end responsibility, requires correct player data syncing with the UI, Medium system priority
Players need to know where each cells belong, High user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to complete challenges
requirements.description:
Allows game progression
Priority:
Tied to validation and game state knowledge, High system priority
Crucial for game advancement and engagement, High user priority

requirements.text: The game must be able to update the grid after each round
requirements.description:
Updates the UI elements of the grid for the player
Priority:
Basic to game state but mostly UI related, Medium system priority
Players rely on the grid to understand whats happening, High player priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to set a timer
requirements.description:
Tied to turn logic or challenge limits ensuring paced gameplay
Priority:
Timers affect gameplay directly, user and system High priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to select language
requirements.description:
Enables users to interact with the game in their preferred language
Priority:
Requires internationalization/translation support, low system priority
Improves accessibility and user comfort, medium user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to exit the game
requirements.description:
Allows the player leave the game at any time.
Priority:
Requires "cleanup" and game flow handling, Medium system priority
Gives control and respect to player choice ,High user priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to create a game
requirements.description:
Initializes a new game with required settings, grid, and players.
Priority:
Basic to game flow management, High system priority
Essential for starting gameplay, High user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to join the queue for a game
requirements.description:
Enables players to wait for a new game to start when one is not yet full or ready.
Priority:
Requires game coordination and player management, High system priority
Provides access and smooth entry into gameplay, High user priority

requirements.text: The player must be able to see other players' information
requirements.description:
Displays data such as name, score, or owned cells to support awareness and strategy
Priority:
Requires real-time sync and data share but UI based, Medium system priority
Enhances competition and engagement, High user priority

requirements.text: The game must be able to operate turn based
requirements.description:
Controls the game flow so players act one at a time in a predefined order
Priority:
Turn Based mechanic defines the structure of the game flow, Both user and system High priority

requirements.text: The system must be able to automatically remove inactive players after a set time.
requirements.description:
Important for multiplayer flow provided with tracking and fairness.
Priority:
Requires activity tracking and game edits, High system priority
Players like fairness in gameplay as well as no time wasting, Medium user priority

requirements.text: The system must allow players to vote for a rematch at the end of a game.
requirements.description:
Increases engagement and competitiveness for the players.
System must manage votes and session reset.
Priority:
System just tracks votes, Medium system priority
Players like a competitive gameplay mechanics, High user priority
